card.name: Words just before 'adjustment' or 'revised'
card.fires_on: Words right before an expected 'adjustment', 'revision' or 'reworked', such as 'downward', 'upward', 'dosage' or 'be' after 'may have to'. Seen in drug interaction text and in news about changed forecasts.
